text:
Ava (partnerships): FYI marketplace asks for our SOC2 + pen-test bundle AND explicit consent logs for partner data retention. Who owns this?
Marco (security): We have SOC2 summary + full pen report. Do they want raw scan outputs or redacted artifacts? :thinking:
Ava (partnerships): Marketplace guidance: no PII. So raw outputs need redaction before share.
Priya (legal): Agreed — legal won't allow PII or customer identifiers. Any logs showing customer IDs require signed consent from the partner.
Jai (marketplace): Listing team needs the package by EOD Friday to hit the joint announcement window.
Sam (eng-infra): I can produce a presigned bundle. Propose 7-day presign TTL, one-time-download flag simulated via short expiry + manifest.
Marco (security): Redaction plan: vuln-scan -> redact script -> generate audit-exec-summary.pdf + redaction-manifest.json (only hashes + line counts). We also include an attestation signed by security.
Ava (partnerships): Who authors the attestation and runs the redaction? Marco owns redaction script? Sam runs the upload?
Marco (security): Security owns the redaction script and attestation content. Sam handles packaging and presigns. Priya will finalize consent template.
Priya (legal): Required deliverables checklist (legal): signed consent OR explicit partner opt-in, redaction attestation, SOC2 cover letter, pen-test exec summary, file manifest with owners and TTL. No raw PII.
Jai (marketplace): Also request: include retention_policy in manifest (e.g., presign_retention_days=7) + contact for takedown.
Sam (eng-infra): I'll set server-side encryption (SSE-KMS) and private ACL. Sample command I will run:

```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-marketplace-bundles/partner-x/bundle-20260323-01.tar.gz --expires-in 604800
```

Sam (eng-infra): Will also attach manifest with HMAC of bundle and owner emails.
Marco (security): For redaction proof, we will include before/after file hashes produced by the script (only hashes, no original plaintext). That serves as tamper-evidence.
Ava (partnerships): Let's do a short sync at 14:00 today to finalize the bundle contents. Jai, Priya, Marco, Sam — can you join?
Priya (legal): 14:00 works for me.
Jai (marketplace): 14:00 ok.
Sam (eng-infra): I'll be there.
Marco (security): Ping me 10m before.
deploy-bot: Packaging job queued: bundle id 20260323-01. Expected artifacts: soc2-summary.pdf, pen-exec-summary.pdf, redaction-manifest.json, consent-template.pdf, bundle.tar.gz.
Sam (eng-infra): Package uploaded to staging S3 path. Will generate presign after redaction attestation.
Ava (partnerships): Awesome — once presign is ready I'll notify the SI partner and marketplace contact. Keep thread updated with the presign URL and expiry. :thumbsup:
